scripts.build:ui: node --check apps/identity/public/app.js && node --check apps/identity/public/api.js && node --check apps/identity/public/bootstrap.js && node --check apps/identity/public/dates.js
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:workers: mkdir -p .wrangler/build/identity .wrangler/build/gateway && wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify --env staging --outdir .wrangler/build/identity --outfile .wrangler/build/identity/bundle.multipart --config apps/identity/wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/extract-worker-bundle.mjs .wrangler/build/identity/bundle.multipart .wrangler/build/identity/worker.js && wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify --env staging --outdir .wrangler/build/gateway --outfile .wrangler/build/gateway/bundle.multipart --config apps/gateway/wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/extract-worker-bundle.mjs .wrangler/build/gateway/bundle.multipart .wrangler/build/gateway/worker.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:workers && vitest run --config integration/vitest.gateway.config.ts && vitest run --config integration/vitest.identity.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && vitest run && npm run test --workspace @ws-proxy/identity --if-present && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.types:workers: wrangler types --config apps/identity/wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false apps/identity/worker-configuration.d.ts && wrangler types --config apps/gateway/wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false apps/gateway/worker-configuration.d.ts
